svg.text: Three containers on one Azure VM: two ingestion services and a dashboard serving the API, the model and the page.
VM to storage: managed identity on one
container. VM to database: two users, one
read-only. Secrets only in .env files on the VM.
Docker starts at boot; reboot tested.
Model is baked into the image: retrain,
Logs: structured JSON, rotated 3 x 10 MB.
